scientific_integrity: Algebraic all-length proof, exact transfer-matrix enumeration, and two standalone computational cross-checks are supplied. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only three-state threshold-one synchronous Greenberg–Hastings dynamics with a single directed successor neighbor on a cyclic ring of length at least three is covered; no claim for undirected rings or other rules. Earliest directly day-verified source is the 1993 arXiv submission; earlier supporting journal literature has no independently verified day of original public appearance. Absolute historical priority and independent mathematical validation are not claimed.
title: Three-update pulse sorting and a cubic extinction law for one-way excitable rings
